data.content_ref: inline:The claim identifies the single cross-city mechanism as an evaporative cooling deficit that 'scales inversely with urban vegetation and irrigation.' Yet the mechanism text immediately contradicts this by arguing arid cities exhibit a larger gap precisely because urban irrigation reintroduces latent heat capacity, making irrigation a driver of a larger gap, not a smaller one. These are opposite monotonic claims about the same variable (irrigation), so the target does not coherently specify a single mechanism.
